title: Add deterministic RAG replay workbench and snapshot replayer
author: Sofia Nguyen
description: Motivation: debugging RAG sessions and reproducing regressions is hard when tool calls, retrieval snapshots, and model nondeterminism are involved. This PR introduces a lightweight deterministic replay workbench and a compact session snapshot format (.ragsnap) that records retrieval results, tool-call logs, prompt scaffolding, model RNG seeds, and a minimal KV-cache fingerprint so teams can reliably replay and debug RAG runs locally or in a CI-backed replay runner. Summary of changes: 1) CLI: rag-snap record/replay commands to capture a live session from the local dev proxy and to replay it deterministically; 2) Replayer UI: a tiny single-page workbench that can load .ragsnap files and step through the session (prompt -> retrieval -> tool -> model tokens) with a timeline and inline diffs; 3) Example templates: two RAG templates (agent+tool-calling and plain retriever+generator) with annotated checkpoints and a sample session recorded against the sample index; 4) Telemetry hooks: optional linkage to Redwood Console snapshot IDs so telemetry traces can point to a replayable artifact; 5) Tests: smoke playback unit tests and an integration e2e that runs a recorded session headless in CI. Rationale: small, reproducible artifacts that include retrieval snapshots and deterministic seeds make root-cause analysis for hallucinations, regressions after kernel changes, and batching-induced behavior much faster. Migration notes: the new .ragsnap format is opt-in and lives in examples/recordings; it does not change any public API surfaces. Checklist: - [x] Implement CLI recorder + replayer - [x] Add SPA replayer UI and timeline view - [x] Add two annotated RAG templates with authoring notes - [x] Add tests and CI job (replay-smoke) - [x] Docsite page that explains how to record/replay and interpret snapshots - [x] Add telemetry links to console snapshots Files of interest and short explanation: examples/replay/sample-session.ragsnap captures a small user session against the sample index (used by the e2e); src/playground/replayer/* contains the UI and a compact playback engine; examples/templates/deterministic-agent.yaml and examples/templates/deterministic-retriever.yaml are the annotated quickstarts. Related: this complements ENG-1223 (replayable telemetry) and follows design notes in PM-452. Known limitations: large indices are not captured (we snapshot top-k retrieval results only), some external tool side effects are stubbed during record/replay (we capture tool outputs instead), and the current KV-cache fingerprint is minimal (future PR will include full token-level cache dumps for deep debugging).

release_notes: Introduces a deterministic replay workbench and .ragsnap snapshot format for reproducible RAG debugging; adds rag-snap CLI for recording and deterministic replay; includes two annotated RAG quickstart templates and a sample recording; adds replay-smoke CI job to validate deterministic playback; opt-in feature, no breaking API changes.
notes_for_sre: The replay-smoke CI job runs headless playback against a small sample index. It should be scheduled on linux runners with Chrome headless. If intermittents appear, run tests/replayer/smoke_playback.test.ts locally to collect a .ragsnap and attach to the failing CI run.
migration_guidance: The .ragsnap artifacts are stored in examples/replay and are opt-in; teams can record sessions with `rag-snap record --out path/sample.ragsnap` and replay with `rag-snap replay path/sample.ragsnap --tolerance 0.001`. Telemetry links are optional and require a console snapshot id environment variable when recording.
notes: This PR is intentionally small scope: focused on developer debugging ergonomics. Follow-up work (ENG-2345) will add fuller KV-cache dumps and support for large-index offline snapshotting.
